states.message: Welcome to Branch operations and SOPs! Please select a topic you would like to learn about.
At opening, verify the vault count matches the previous closing balance and log system start-up. At closing, reconcile cash and gold stock before locking the vault.
Cash beyond the branch's retention limit must be deposited promptly, and vault access always requires dual custody — never one person alone.
Pledged gold is stored in sealed, labeled packets matching the loan account number, inside the vault — never left at a counter or desk overnight.
Branches must maintain accurate registers (pledge, auction, cash) and be ready for surprise audits at any time — discrepancies must be reported immediately, not adjusted quietly.
